accepted.s: The eCourts Mission Mode Project has been in place since which year?
accepted.x: The eCourts integrated Mission Mode Project has been in place since 2007.
accepted.tq: Use the numerical-year distinction among closely related MMP dates.
accepted.sec: MMPs in news - Passport Seva, MCA21, eCourts, e-District, CCTNS, e-Procurement

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT a function associated with the eCourts Mission Mode Project?
accepted.x: e-Filing, online cause lists and case tracking are associated with eCourts. Online company filing is the function of MCA21.
accepted.tq: Find the mismatched function by separating judicial services from corporate filing.
accepted.sec: MMPs in news - Passport Seva, MCA21, eCourts, e-District, CCTNS, e-Procurement

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the phases of the eCourts Mission Mode Project:
1. Phase I covered 2007–15.
2. Phase II covered 2015–23.
3. Phase III covers 2023–27.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements correctly state the periods of Phases I, II and III of eCourts.
accepted.tq: Check each date range independently before selecting the coded combination.
accepted.sec: MMPs in news - Passport Seva, MCA21, eCourts, e-District, CCTNS, e-Procurement

accepted.s: CCTNS is implemented under the administrative responsibility of which Ministry?
o: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
accepted.x: CCTNS is associated with the Ministry of Home Affairs.
accepted.tq: Apply the ‘who handles this function?’ method to identify the responsible ministry.
accepted.sec: MMPs in news - Passport Seva, MCA21, eCourts, e-District, CCTNS, e-Procurement

accepted.s: CCTNS, started in 2009, primarily links which of the following?
o: District treasuries, banks and post offices
Passport offices, embassies and immigration counters
Police stations, State headquarters and central police organisations
accepted.x: CCTNS links police stations, State headquarters and central police organisations. It was started in 2009.
accepted.tq: Identify the operational network from the institutions named in the option.
accepted.sec: MMPs in news - Passport Seva, MCA21, eCourts, e-District, CCTNS, e-Procurement

accepted.s: MCA21 is correctly associated with which of the following?
o: Online passport applications under the Ministry of External Affairs
Online company filing under the Ministry of Corporate Affairs
Police-station networking under the Ministry of Home Affairs
accepted.x: MCA21 is a Ministry of Corporate Affairs initiative for online company filing and is a G2B service.
accepted.tq: Use the ministry-function pairing to distinguish neighbouring MMPs.
accepted.sec: MMPs in news - Passport Seva, MCA21, eCourts, e-District, CCTNS, e-Procurement

accepted.s: MCA21 is regarded as which of the following in relation to the National e-Governance Plan?

A judicial body under the eCourts project

The central ministry for corporate affairs

accepted.s: e-Kranti is also known as which of the following?

accepted.s: What is the vision statement of e-Kranti?

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT a principle of e-Kranti?
accepted.x: The principles include transformation not translation, integrated not individual services, and cloud by default. Paper-first delivery is not an e-Kranti principle.
accepted.tq: Locate the one option that reverses the digital-first orientation.
accepted.sec: e-Kranti - principles, MMP count, relation to NeGP

accepted.s:
Which one of the following combinations contains only principles of e-Kranti?
1. Mobile first
2. Language localisation
3. Process re-engineering in every MMP
4. Cloud by default
accepted.x: Mobile first, language localisation, process re-engineering in every MMP and cloud by default are all stated principles of e-Kranti.
accepted.tq: Check whether every listed principle belongs to the same framework before selecting the all-inclusive code.
accepted.sec: e-Kranti - principles, MMP count, relation to NeGP
